name: Finance, SACCO, Microfinance and Chama
scope_from_master_specification: Members/KYC; savings, deposits, withdrawals, shares/contributions; groups; loan products/applications/assessment/approval/disbursement; interest, penalties, schedules and repayments; guarantors/collateral; statements, delinquency/restructuring, dividends, portfolio/risk reports, M-Pesa/banks, member portals, meetings, voting/resolutions and AI insights.
implemented_scope: Tenant- and branch-scoped member registration and safe member listing
Encrypted KYC payload and keyed identity fingerprint
Audited protected KYC access and independent verify/reject review
Tenant-scoped savings deposits and share contributions
Four-eyes savings withdrawal approval with balance recheck before posting
Derived balances from append-only ledger entries
PostgreSQL forced RLS and CI runtime-role isolation tests for member and financial records
required_before_production: Savings product configuration, account terms, limits and withdrawal notice policies
Share redemption, member exit and compensating correction/reversal workflows
Accounting general-ledger integration, cash/bank reconciliation and financial close controls
Group/chama membership, contributions, meetings, voting and resolutions
Loan products, applications, affordability assessment, guarantors and collateral
Multi-level loan approval, disbursement, interest, penalties and repayment schedules
Delinquency, restructuring, dividends, statements and portfolio/risk reporting
Authorized payment integrations and settlement reconciliation
Production role/key rehearsal, monitoring, backup/restore, security review and UAT
